root_cause: Windows has no production process/container observation backend. Actual MCP child creation succeeds, but McpWriterObserver::child_started calls observe_container, whose Windows observe branch unconditionally refuses. MCP settles the child before initialize and returns mcp_child_observation_failed. The fixture still waits for its readiness file and panics after 30 seconds.
